1. **Sectors 1–4 (The 1989 Sublevel B2 Execution Reels):** Exonerate Sound Engineer Marcus Hale by recovering the runout and telemetry keys in `/forensics/index.html`.

3. **Sector 6 (Reel SD-0010 "Two Voices" Counterpoint Lock):** Load Button 4 in `/forensics/signal_lab.html` and engage `[HARMONIC COUNTERPOINT LOCK (14.2 HZ)]`.
4. **Sector 7 (Phase IV: The Quantum Ouroboros — Hardest Collaborative Puzzle):** Requires combining Fragment α (6-way XOR parity of Echoes 1–6 in `anemoia_harmony.html`), Fragment β (4-node Fractal Marcus drift anchor in `fractal_marcus.html`), Fragment γ (Q-Link aperture delta in `dead_hand_protocol.html`), and Fragment δ (simultaneously engaging BOTH Phase Null and Counterpoint Lock on Button 4 in `signal_lab.html` to reveal the `OUROBOROS-FOLD` syntax).
